title: Equations for the reindexed explicit cycle-pullback tower
statement: Let $A,B,F,T,\pi,N$ and $X_i,\delta_i,e_i,V_i$ be the explicit functor-category construction [def-pc-cycle-pullback-tower-data-stage3]. For every $i\in\mathbf Z$, $\delta_i\delta_{i+1}=0$ and $e_i d_F^i=\delta_i e_{i+1}$ as natural transformations. No boundedness of $F$, epimorphism hypothesis, or preservation of limits by $T$ is assumed.

proof.text: For a stage s, its successor differential composed with s.d vanishes by kernel.condition. Its successor augmentation composed with the target differential equals the successor differential composed with s.e by pullback.condition. These two local assertions are already proved as step_square and step_comm in the explicit tower module.

For i<N, prove equality of the selected stage at i with the successor of the selected stage at i+1. The private pair_square and pair_comm lemmas transport the local equations across this stage equality. Expand differential and augmentation, compose successive eqToHom transports, and apply the pair equations; target_transport moves the degree-equality morphism through the target differential. For i=N, pair_comm uses the initial zero stage, while the next raw differential and augmentation are zero. For i>N the current raw maps are zero. These cases prove both equations in Lean without any unproved auxiliary theorem.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 05T7 (1); explicit formalization in the abelian functor category by S3
